description: Upgrade plan to migrate Java project to latest LTS versions

tasks.requirements: Upgrade JDK to Java 21 LTS. Update build configuration files (pom.xml or build.gradle) to target Java 21. Address any deprecated APIs or breaking changes introduced in Java 21.
tasks.summary: Upgraded Java from 17 to 21. Updated pom.xml java.version property. Modernized API usage: Paths.get() replaced with Path.of() in LocalFileStorageService.java and LocalFileProcessingService.java. Build passed and unit tests passed.

tasks.description: Upgrade Spring Boot to version 3.4 (latest stable)
tasks.requirements: Upgrade Spring Boot to version 3.4 and Spring Framework to 6.x. Migrate from javax.* to jakarta.* namespace. Update dependencies and configuration properties for Spring Boot 3.x compatibility. Address any breaking changes in Spring Boot 3.x.
tasks.summary: Upgraded Spring Boot from 3.2.1 to 3.4.5 via 3.3.13. Fixed CVE-2025-49146 by upgrading postgresql driver to 42.7.7. Updated @Bean methods to package-private convention. Build passed and unit tests passed. No javax to jakarta migration needed as project was already on Jakarta EE.
